answer: Sybil resistance follows from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained, honest service preserves weight, while inactivity or misconduct rapidly erodes it. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming paths; reciprocity-weighted transitivity therefore gives it no leverage to pass consensus, whether named saffron, grove, or orchard.
